detail.title: Mapping the Synthesis of Autonomous Inquiry
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the integration of problem formulation and evaluation in computational creativity frameworks, utilizing active inference and empirical source evidence to refine understanding of autonomous inquiry.

detail.statement: Computational creativity frameworks require robust integration between formulation and evaluation components, supported by active inference and drift-diffusion mechanisms, for agents to autonomously navigate and identify novel, worthwhile problems.
